author: Megaprojects
description:
The Bradley Fighting Vehicle has served the US Army for decades, excelling in Desert Storm and Ukraine. Now two designs compete to replace it: Rheinmetall's Lynx and General Dynamics' Wolf. Both feature improved armour, active protection systems, and a new 50-millimetre chain gun with programmable rounds designed to counter drones.
